### Frontier Opens First Class Reservations, Expands Cabin Transformation With More Extra-Legroom Premium Seats and In-Seat Power


November 10, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/257736825/files/doc_news/Frontier-Opens-First-Class-Reservations-Expands-Cabin-Transformation-With-More-Extra-Legroom-Premium-Seats-and-In-Seat-Power-2026.pdf)


*Combined with Starlink Wi-Fi, Frontier is redefining travel by delivering* *greater comfort, choice and connectivity at an exceptional value*


DENVER


, Nov. 10, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Frontier Airlines (Nasdaq: ULCC) today opened reservations for its new First Class seats and unveiled additional cabin enhancements that will bring more extra-legroom Premium seating and in-seat power to its aircraft. The enhancements will complement Frontier's previously announced Starlink Wi-Fi, reshaping how customers experience Frontier by delivering more comfort, choice and connectivity while staying true to the airline's low fares commitment. Installation of First Class and extra-legroom seats has begun, with completion expected March 5, 2027.


The new seating configuration will offer extra legroom throughout the first eight rows of the aircraft. First Class customers will enjoy spacious seats in a two-by-two configuration with up to 37 inches of pitch, while seats in rows three through eight will offer extra legroom with up to 34 inches of pitch. Reservations for both seating options are available now for travel beginning on March 5, 2027, with introductory pricing starting at $90 one-way for a Premium bundle which includes extra-legroom seating, and $129 one-way for a First bundle which includes First Class seating.*


Building on the seating transformation, in-seat power and Starlink Wi-Fi will begin rolling out in 2027, with enhancements becoming available aircraft by aircraft throughout the year.


"We're transforming what customers can expect when they fly Frontier," said Bobby Schroeter, Chief Marketing Officer, Frontier Airlines. "First Class seating, more room to stretch out, in-seat power and fast, reliable Starlink Wi-Fi will bring a new level of comfort and convenience to flying with us. We're continuing to deliver the great value our customers count on, combining more comfort and choice with Frontier's low fares."


The transformed onboard experience will include:


**First Class comfort**


- Spacious First Class seats in a two-by-two configuration in the first two rows of the cabin, offering more personal space with no middle seats
- Up to 37 inches of seat pitch
- Introductory pricing starting at $129 one-way* for Frontier's First bundle, which includes seat, two checked bags, a carry-on bag, and Board First priority boarding. Customers are now able to select for flights starting March 5, 2027


**Extra-legroom seating**


- Extra-legroom seating in rows three through eight
- Up to 34 inches of seat pitch
- UpFront Plus seating in select rows, guaranteeing an empty adjacent middle seat
- Introductory pricing starting at $90 one-way* for Frontier's Premium bundle, which includes seat, a carry-on bag, and Board First priority boarding. Customers are now able to select for flights starting March 5, 2027


**In-seat power**


- In-seat power using USB-C at every seat in the first eight rows, enabling customers to keep their devices charged and stay connected
- Installation beginning in 2027 and progressing throughout the year


**High-speed Starlink Wi-Fi**


- Fast, reliable connectivity enabling customers to work, browse, stream, and stay connected during their flight
- Installation beginning in 2027 and progressing throughout the year


"Together, these enhancements will give customers more ways to relax, stay productive, and enjoy their time onboard – with the same low fares they expect from Frontier," Schroeter said.


Customers can explore seating options and book now at[FlyFrontier.com](http://flyfrontier.com/) .


****Introductory pricing details:*** *Subject to availability. Available only for new bookings at[FlyFrontier.com](http://flyfrontier.com/) and the Frontier mobile app. To receive promotional pricing, flight and bundle must be purchased by 11:59 pm Eastern time on November 16, 2026; for nonstop domestic travel on select days of the week from March 5, 2027 through April 5, 2027; bundle must be purchased at the time of flight purchase. Price is per passenger, per direction.* *Not all markets are available for all dates of travel.* *All travel rules will apply, including Frontier Airlines'*[Contract of Carriage](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4819077-1&h=101566526&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.flyfrontier.com%2Flegal%2Fcontract-of-carriage&a=Contract+of+Carriage) *.*


**About Frontier Airlines:** Frontier Airlines, Inc. (Nasdaq: ULCC) is a premier value airline operating one of the youngest and most fuel-efficient fleets in the United States. With a growing network and continued investment in product upgrades, including the introduction of Starlink, the fastest Wi-Fi in the sky, First Class seating and enhanced loyalty benefits, Frontier is giving customers more comfort, flexibility, and rewards while keeping fares low.
